info.desc: Above is the only studio album by the American rock supergroup Mad Season, released on March 15, 1995 through Columbia Records. The album has been certified gold by the RIAA in the United States. During the production of Pearl Jam's Vitalogy, guitarist Mike McCready went into rehab in Minneapolis, Minnesota, where he met The Lamont Cranston Band bassist John Baker Saunders. In 1994, when the two returned to Seattle, they formed a side band with Screaming Trees drummer Barrett Martin. Immediately the trio set up rehearsal time together and began writing material. podcast.body: The album "Above" was released by Mad Season in mid-1995 and sold a million copies. The band itself originated from Mike McCready and John Baker Saunders bonding in rehab. "And Mad Season managed to release one album called Above, which sold a million copies."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
